tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical Capacity - The Bidder must demonstrate a proven history of successfully executing real estate projects. To satisfy this requirement, the Bidder must have completed Eligible Projects, cumulatively totaling a minimum of 3,50,000 square feet, within the five (5) financial years immediately preceding the Bid Due Date. For the purposes of this requirement, the final financial year considered for eligibility shall be Fiscal Year 2024-2025. Furthermore, at least one (1) of these Eligible Projects shall have a minimum size of 1,75,000 square feet (2.2.2 A (i))

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annex II to Appendix I Technical Capacity of the Bidder
Others -- ANNEX-IV to Appendix I - Details of Eligible Projects

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical Capacity The Bidder shall demonstrate financial capacity and project revenue generation within the five (5) financial years immediately preceding the Bid Due Date, with Fiscal Year 2024-2025 being the final year considered for eligibility. The Bidder shall provide documentary evidence, duly certified by statutory auditors with UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number), establishing that a) the aggregate amount of expenditure incurred towards execution, b) payment received, and / or c) revenue earned (whether from its client(s) and/or self-owned project(s)) in relation to the construction, development, maintenance, and/or operations of the eligible projects, is at least INR 2,70,00,00,000 (Rupees Two Hundred and Seventy Crores Only). The documentary evidence shall further prove that at least one (1) eligible project within such period is not less than INR 67,50,00,000 (Rupees Sixty-Seven Crores and Fifty Lakhs only) (2.2.2 (A) (ii))

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annex II to Appendix I Technical Capacity of the Bidder
Others -- ANNEX-IV to Appendix I - Details of Eligible Projects

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical Capacity To demonstrate relevant experience in leasing or sales, the Bidder must submit documented proof of having successfully leased or sold a minimum of 175,000 square feet of Super Built Up or saleable area from a single Eligible Project within the five (5) financial years immediately preceding the Bid Due Date. For this purpose, the final financial year considered shall be Fiscal Year 2024 2025.Acceptable documentation shall include auditor certified copies (with UDIN) of executed lease agreements. Multiple lease agreements pertaining to the same space shall not be considered. Similarly, in the case of sale transactions, multiple sale agreements for the same unit or space shall not be accepted (2.2.2 (A) (iii))

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annex II to Apendix I Technical Capacity of the bidder
Others -- Annex IV to Appendix I Details of Eligible Projects

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be an entity registered in India and may be a single entity, incorporated as a Company, or a group of entities (the Consortium), coming together to implement the Project. However, no Bidder applying individually or as a member of a Consortium, as the case may be, can be member of another Bidder. The term Bidder used herein would apply to both a single entity and a Consortium (2.2.1 (a))

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Memorandum and Articles of Association

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A Bidder may be a private entity acting individually or intending to form a Consortium through a formal agreement or an existing arrangement. In the case of a Consortium, eligibility shall be subject to the conditions specified under Clause 2.2.5 of this RFQ-CUMRFP. (2.2.1 (b))
The Bidder (each member in case of consortium) shall have been in continuous existence and operation for a minimum period of five (5) years preceding the Bid Due Date. (2.2.1 (f))

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Income Tax Returns for the preceding five Financial Years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder (Letterhead of the Bidder / Letterhead of Lead Member in case of a Consortium) should submit as per the format at Appendix I and complete with its annexures (Annex I, II, III, IV and V)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Appendix I and its annexures (Annex I, II, III, IV and V)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit a Power of Attorney, duly signed and notarized, as per the format at Appendix II, authorizing the signatory of the Bid to commit the Bidder. In case of the Consortium, the members should submit a Power of Attorney in favour of the Lead Member as per the format at Appendix III (2.2.4)
If the Bidder is a Consortium, members of the Consortium shall enter into a binding Joint Bidding Agreement, substantially in the form specified at Appendix IV for the purpose of submitting the Bid

The Bidder must be registered with the appropriate authorities under the Income Tax Act and the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime. The Bidder shall be in compliance with all applicable tax laws and regulations, including but not limited to the submission of Income Tax Returns for the last three (3) financial years and the latest GST return as on the date of bid submission.(2.2.1 (e))

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Latest GST Returns for the month of March-2026
Others -- Income Tax Returns for the last three financial years, i.e., FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any other requirements as specified in the RFP document and/or Corrigendum
Bidders/ each Consortium members duly audited balance sheet and profit and loss account with UDIN for the preceding 5 (five) financial years (2.14.1 (vi))

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Financial Capacity - The Bidder (including its Associates) shall demonstrate a minimum Net Worth ("Financial Capacity") of INR 33,75,00,000 (Indian Rupees ThirtyThree Crore Seventy-Five Lakh Only) in at least two (2) of the three (3) financial years immediately preceding the Bid Due Date. In the case of a Consortium, only the combined technical capacity and Net Worth of those Consortium Members holding an equity share of 26% or more shall be considered for evaluation. The Members, whose Net Worth is accounted for in the qualification, shall not reduce their equity stake below 26% in the Consortium for Min. Each such Member of the Consortium shall make a minimum investment of not less than 5% of the total project cost in the Project. For the purposes of this RFQ-cum-RFP, in case the Bidder is a company, Net Cash Accruals shall mean Profit after Tax + Depreciation. 2.2.2 (B)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited Balance Sheet with UDIN number for preceding 5 financial years
Others -- Audited Profit and Loss Statement with UDIN number for preceding 5 financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All Self-Declarations pertaining to the qualification criteria stipulated in Clauses 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 shall be submitted in the form of a sworn affidavit on a Rs. 100 stamp paper and should be notarized. (2.2.1 (explanation) (2))

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Certificate(s) from statutory auditors with UDIN of the Bidder or its Associates specifying the net worth of the Bidder, as at the close of any of the preceding 5 (five) financial years (immediately preceding the Bid Due Date), provided that the specified net worth shall be at least INR 35 Crores in order to qualify for the Bid. The statutory auditor(s) shall also specify that the methodology adopted for calculating such net worth conforms to the provisions of this Clause 2.2.3 (iv). For the purpose of this RFQ-cum-RFP, net worth (Net Worth) shall mean the aggregate value of the paid-up share capital and all reserves created out of the profits and securities premium account, after deducting the aggregate value of the accumulated loses, deferred expenditure and miscellaneous expenditure not written off, as per the audited balance sheet, but does not include reserves created out of revaluation of assets, write back of depreciation and amalgamation (2.2.3 (iv))

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any entity which has been barred by the Central/State Government, or PSUs Central/State) or any entity controlled by it, from participating in any project (BOT or otherwise), and the bar subsists as on the date of Bid, would not be eligible to submit a Bid, either individually or as member of a Consortium. (2.2.7)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A Bidder including any Consortium Member or Associate should, in the last 5 (five) years, have neither failed to perform on any contract, as evidenced by imposition of a penalty by an arbitral or judicial authority or a judicial pronouncement or arbitration award against the Bidder, Consortium member or Associate, as the case may be, nor has been expelled from any project or contract by any public entity nor have had any contract terminated by any public entity for breach by such Bidder, Consortium Member or Associate and any such bidder would not be eligible to submit a bid, either individually or as a member of a Consortium. (2.2.8)
